name: presumptiveTbRegisterBase
description: Presumptive TB Register (MOH/REG/DNTLDP/02): one row per TB encounter (presumptiveTbEncounters), oldest first, in the register's columns (the names of PresumptiveTbRow in the O3 register). (B) CCC number (28, else 50); (G) national ID (5) and Client Registry number (55) on their own lines; (H) nearest landmark (attribute 31) and village, and phone (10); (J) the latest HTS HIV result (296 / 297, 1357) on or before the encounter, in full -- Positive / Negative / Inconclusive / Not Done -- and its date; (K) Sputum where a smear was done; (L) chest X-ray N / SG / AO / ND; (N) culture result with any resistance (R, H, Z, E) and date; (O) smear method and result (FM / ZN, 0 / Scanty / + / ++ / +++) and date; (P) DRTB where resistance is recorded, DSTB where smear or culture is positive or a TB type is recorded, No TB where the smear is negative, culture not positive and the X-ray normal or not done; (Q) started on anti-TB treatment (1113) and its date. Sample date, other radiology, TPT and remarks are not recorded yet.

join.joinCondition: pn.person_name_id = (SELECT pn2.person_name_id FROM amrs.person_name pn2 WHERE pn2.person_id = t.patient_id AND pn2.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn2.preferred DESC, pn2.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)

pa.person_address_id = (SELECT pa2.person_address_id FROM amrs.person_address pa2 WHERE pa2.person_id = t.patient_id AND pa2.voided = 0 ORDER BY pa2.preferred DESC, pa2.person_address_id DESC LIMIT 1)

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = t.patient_id AND pi.voided = 0 AND pi.identifier_type IN (28, 50) ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC LIMIT 1)
IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, t.enc_date) < 1, CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, p.birthdate, t.enc_date), ' Mo'), CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, t.enc_date), ' Yrs'))

(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = t.patient_id AND pi.voided = 0 AND pi.identifier_type = 5 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

columns.comment: (G) lower: Client Registry number (identifier type 55), in place of UPI

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = t.patient_id AND pi.voided = 0 AND pi.identifier_type = 55 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)
NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(', ', (SELECT a.value FROM amrs.person_attribute a WHERE a.person_id = t.patient_id AND a.voided = 0 AND a.person_attribute_type_id = 31 LIMIT 1), pa.city_village), '')
(SELECT a.value FROM amrs.person_attribute a WHERE a.person_id = t.patient_id AND a.voided = 0 AND a.person_attribute_type_id = 10 LIMIT 1)

CASE (SELECT ho.value_coded FROM amrs.encounter h JOIN amrs.obs ho ON ho.encounter_id = h.encounter_id AND ho.concept_id = 1357 AND ho.voided = 0 WHERE h.patient_id = t.patient_id AND h.encounter_type IN (296, 297) AND h.voided = 0 AND h.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(t.enc_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY h.encounter_datetime DESC, ho.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 703 THEN 'Positive' WHEN 664 THEN 'Negative' WHEN 1138 THEN 'Inconclusive' ELSE 'Not Done' END

columns.comment: (J) upper: the latest HTS result (encounters 296, 297; final result 1357) on or before the TB encounter, at any facility -- in full; Not Done without one
(J) lower: the date of that HTS test

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT DATE(h.encounter_datetime) FROM amrs.encounter h JOIN amrs.obs ho ON ho.encounter_id = h.encounter_id AND ho.concept_id = 1357 AND ho.voided = 0 WHERE h.patient_id = t.patient_id AND h.encounter_type IN (296, 297) AND h.voided = 0 AND h.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(t.enc_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY h.encounter_datetime DESC, ho.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)
NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', t.culture_text, IF(t.resistant_to IS NOT NULL, CONCAT('Resistant: ', t.resistant_to), NULL)), '')

CASE WHEN t.has_res = 1 THEN 'DRTB' WHEN t.smear_pos = 1 OR t.culture_pos = 1 OR t.has_tb_type = 1 THEN 'DSTB' WHEN t.smear_neg = 1 AND IFNULL(t.culture_pos, 0) = 0 AND (t.xray_code IS NULL OR t.xray_code IN ('N', 'ND')) THEN 'No TB' END

columns.comment: (Q) lower: the treatment start date; no sub-county TB number is recorded
Bacteriologically confirmed: a positive smear (Scanty, +, ++, +++) or culture growth -- for the ACF Facility Summary Tool (6), and clinically diagnosed (7) is diagnosed without it
